mapper.select: SELECT PROD_ID as prodId, PROD_CODE as prodCode, PROD_NAME as name, PROD_PRICE as price, IMAGE_URL as imageUrl, SOURCE as source, BOARD_TYPE as boardType, REG_DATE as regDate FROM Common_Product ORDER BY REG_DATE DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT p.PROD_ID as prodId, p.PROD_NAME as name, p.PROD_PRICE as price, p.IMAGE_URL as imageUrl, p.SOURCE as source, p.BOARD_TYPE as boardType, h.PREV_PRICE as prevPrice, ((h.PREV_PRICE - p.PROD_PRICE) / h.PREV_PRICE * 100) as dropRate FROM Common_Product p JOIN ( SELECT PROD_ID, PRICE as PREV_PRICE FROM ( SELECT PROD_ID, PRICE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY PROD_ID ORDER BY REG_DATE DESC) as rn FROM PRICE_HISTORY ) WHERE rn = 2 ) h ON p.PROD_ID = h.PROD_ID ) WHERE dropRate >= 10 OR boardType = 'DROP' ORDER BY REG_DATE DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT rownum rnum, a.* FROM ( SELECT PROD_ID as prodId, PROD_NAME as name, PROD_PRICE as price, IMAGE_URL as imageUrl, ORIGIN_URL as originUrl, SOURCE as communityName, BOARD_TYPE as boardType, REG_DATE as regDate FROM Common_Product
UNION ALL
SELECT DEAL_ID as prodId, TITLE as name, CURRENT_PRICE as price, IMAGE_URL as imageUrl, ORIGIN_URL as originUrl, COMMUNITY_NAME as communityName, 'HOT' as boardType, LAST_UPDATE_DATE as regDate FROM TB_HOTDEAL_TRACKER
ORDER BY regDate DESC ) a WHERE rownum <= #{pageEnd} ) WHERE rnum >= #{pageStart}
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Common_Product) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_HOTDEAL_TRACKER) FROM DUAL

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Common_Product WHERE 1=1
AND PROD_NAME LIKE '%'||#{keyword}||'%' AND PROD_CODE = #{keyword}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT DEAL_ID as prodId, TITLE as name, CURRENT_PRICE as price, START_PRICE as startPrice, IMAGE_URL as imageUrl, ORIGIN_URL as originUrl, MALL_NAME as mallName, COMMUNITY_NAME as communityName, LAST_UPDATE_DATE as regDate FROM TB_HOTDEAL_TRACKER ORDER BY LAST_UPDATE_DATE DESC ) WHERE rownum <= 10
